title: Design System: AI Credit Scoring System

display.purpose: Page-hero scale; the logbook's largest Archivo setting.

verdict.purpose: The monumental probability readout in the verdict block; tabular numerals.

title.purpose: Uppercase section titles, memo heads, brand name; Archivo 800.

label.purpose: Mono uppercase micro-labels: field labels, table headers, verdict labels.

entry.purpose: THE LOG record face and small mono readouts.

shadows.name: sheet
shadows.purpose: The only soft elevation: the open sheet and the memo sheet.

shadows.name: press
shadows.purpose: Hard letterpress offset on the primary button; hover grows to 2.5px.

shadows.name: press-sm
shadows.purpose: Brand mark and small result boxes.

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.purpose: Focus-visible treatment on buttons, inputs, and what-if fields.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: The single easing curve for all transitions and keyframes.

motion.name: stamp-in
motion.purpose: The press: stamps and fresh log entries scale 1.35→0.97→1 with rotation overshoot to -1.2deg.

motion.name: ruler-fill
motion.purpose: Ruler gauge fill scaleX on update.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) — all animation/transition durations collapse to 0.01ms
motion.purpose: Mandatory accessibility override shipped in styles.css.

breakpoints.name: mobile
breakpoints.purpose: Book collapses to one column; tabs become a horizontal scroll row; log caps at 220px; verdict side wraps below.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one filled action on a folio — vermilion with a hard press shadow.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 8px 16px; border: none; border-radius: 2px; background: var(--stamp, #bf3f1f); color: var(--sheet, #fdfcf7); font-family: 'Archivo', sans-serif; font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.03em; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 1.5px 1.5px 0 rgba(31, 42, 51, 0.35); transition: background 220ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), box-shadow 220ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), transform 140ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover:not(:disabled) { background: var(--stamp-deep, #9e3318); box-shadow: 2.5px 2.5px 0 rgba(31, 42, 51, 0.35); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--sheet, #fdfcf7), 0 0 0 4px var(--stamp, #bf3f1f); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.45; cursor: not-allowed; box-shadow: none; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary action on paper: ruled outline, no fill, ink text.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 8px 16px; border: 1.5px solid var(--rule-strong, #a4b2b4); border-radius: 2px; background: transparent; color: var(--ink, #1f2a33); font-family: 'Archivo', sans-serif; font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.03em; cursor: pointer; transition: background 220ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), transform 140ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover:not(:disabled) { border-color: var(--ink, #1f2a33); background: rgba(31, 42, 51, 0.04); } .ds-btn-ghost:active { transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--sheet, #fdfcf7), 0 0 0 4px var(--stamp, #bf3f1f); } .ds-btn-ghost:disabled { opacity: 0.45; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Stamp
components.description: The unit of record — a rotated rubber-stamp mark; mounts with the press animation.
components.css: .ds-stamp { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; padding: 3px 9px; border: 1.5px solid currentColor; border-radius: 2px; background: transparent; color: var(--stamp, #bf3f1f); font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.625rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; white-space: nowrap; transform: rotate(-1.2deg); animation: ds-stamp-in 380ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1) both; } @keyframes ds-stamp-in { 0% { opacity: 0; transform: scale(1.35) rotate(-4deg); } 60% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(0.97) rotate(-1deg); } 100% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1) rotate(-1.2deg); } }

components.name: Stamp — Ledger Green
components.description: Grounded / approve tone of the stamp, used for verification and ok states.
components.css: .ds-stamp { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; padding: 3px 9px; border: 1.5px solid currentColor; border-radius: 2px; background: transparent; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.625rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; white-space: nowrap; transform: rotate(-1.2deg); } .ds-stamp-ok { color: var(--ok, #2e6b46); }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Applicant-form input: white on the sheet, ruled border, vermilion focus ring.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; } .ds-field-label { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.6875rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--ink-soft, #4d5f6b); line-height: 1.5; } .ds-input { padding: 7px 10px; border: 1px solid var(--rule-strong, #a4b2b4); border-radius: 2px; background: #fff; color: var(--ink, #1f2a33); font-family: 'Archivo', sans-serif; font-size: 0.9375rem; transition: border-color 140ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), box-shadow 140ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--stamp, #bf3f1f); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--sheet, #fdfcf7), 0 0 0 4px var(--stamp, #bf3f1f); }

components.name: Index Tab (Active)
components.description: Page-edge section tab in the rail; active tab is a cut sheet edge with a vermilion inset bar.
components.html: Predict 01
components.css: .ds-index-tab { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 9px 12px 9px 18px; text-decoration: none; font-family: 'Archivo', sans-serif; font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.02em; border-radius: 2px 0 0 2px; transition: transform 140ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), background 140ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), color 140ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-index-tab { color: var(--graph-deep, #45607a); background: rgba(253, 252, 247, 0.55); border: 1px solid var(--rule, #cfd6d4); border-right: none; } .ds-index-tab:hover { background: var(--sheet, #fdfcf7); color: var(--ink, #1f2a33); } .ds-index-tab-active { background: var(--sheet, #fdfcf7); color: var(--ink, #1f2a33); border-color: var(--rule-strong, #a4b2b4); box-shadow: -2px 0 0 var(--stamp, #bf3f1f) inset; } .ds-tab-folio { margin-left: auto; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.6875rem; color: var(--stamp, #bf3f1f); }

components.name: Nameplate
components.description: Mono identifier chip used as a row marker in ruled tables.
components.css: .ds-nameplate { display: inline-block; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.6875rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.06em; border: 1px solid var(--rule-strong, #a4b2b4); border-radius: 2px; padding: 2px 7px; background: var(--paper, #f2efe7); color: var(--ink, #1f2a33); white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: State Pill
components.description: Semantic outline pill with a paper-sitting tint fill for stable/warning/drift states.
components.css: .ds-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; padding: 2px 9px; border: 1px solid currentColor; border-radius: 2px; background: transparent; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.625rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-pill-success { color: var(--ok, #2e6b46); background: var(--ok-soft, #e7efe7); } .ds-pill-warning { color: var(--warn, #8f6408); background: var(--warn-soft, #f3ecd8); } .ds-pill-danger { color: var(--bad, #b03a1e); background: var(--bad-soft, #f6e7de); }

components.name: Log Entry — THE LOG
components.description: One stamped, initialed, timestamped record row in the session log; fresh rows press in.
components.html: 14:32:07Scored applicant — grade B, p(default) 0.18PNMANUAL REVIEW
components.css: .ds-log-entry { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto 1fr; gap: 2px 12px; padding: 6px 2px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule, #cfd6d4); font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; animation: ds-entry-in 420ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1) both; transform-origin: left center; } @keyframes ds-entry-in { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(10px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); } } .ds-log-time { grid-column: 1; font-size: 0.625rem; color: var(--ink-faint, #5f707a); padding-top: 2px; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-log-text { grid-column: 2; font-size: 0.75rem; line-height: 1.4; color: var(--ink-soft, #4d5f6b); } .ds-log-initials { grid-column: 1; font-size: 0.5625rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.18em; color: var(--stamp, #bf3f1f); padding-top: 1px; } .ds-stamp-mark { grid-column: 2; justify-self: start; margin-top: 2px; padding: 3px 9px; border: 1.5px solid currentColor; border-radius: 2px; color: var(--warn, #8f6408); font-size: 0.625rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; transform: rotate(-1.2deg); white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Verdict Grade Cell
components.description: The monumental grade: an 84px rotated square cell with a 3px tone-colored border and press shadow.
components.css: .ds-verdict-grade { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 84px; height: 84px; border: 3px solid currentColor; border-radius: 2px; font-family: 'Archivo', sans-serif; font-size: 3rem; font-weight: 800; transform: rotate(-2deg); box-shadow: 2px 2px 0 rgba(31, 42, 51, 0.25); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-verdict-grade.grade-A, .ds-verdict-grade.grade-B { color: var(--ok, #2e6b46); } .ds-verdict-grade.grade-C { color: var(--warn, #8f6408); } .ds-verdict-grade.grade-D, .ds-verdict-grade.grade-E { color: var(--bad, #b03a1e); }

narrative.overview:
This console is a credit analyst's bound lab logbook. Everything sits on an uncoated paper desk; the working surface is one open sheet, ruled with hairlines instead of carded into panels. Iron-gall ink carries the record; a single vermilion is reserved for stamps, the active decision, and verification marks, so every consequential act reads as an impression pressed into the page. Graph blue draws the structure — page-edge tabs, rules, protective-factor evidence — the way a draftsman's grid sits under the ink.

Density is that of a working record: compact, ruled, initialed. Type is a bundled variable Archivo for the shell and display set against bundled JetBrains Mono for entries, readouts, numerals, and labels; nothing loads from a network. The signature move is THE LOG — a session-persisted running record in the rail where every action appends a stamped, initialed, timestamped entry with a press animation. The system refuses the neutral card-and-gauge dashboard: nothing appears and vanishes; everything that happened today is on the page, in order, with initials on it.
keyCharacteristics: Paper ground, one open sheet, hairline rules — never floating cards on gray
Vermilion is a stamp: rare, rotated, pressed — never a fill or a gradient
Uppercase mono labels, tabular numerals, initialed record entries
Square-cut corners (2px radius) everywhere; a logbook is not rounded
One soft sheet shadow plus hard offset "press" shadows — no blurred elevation stacks

rules.name: The Vermilion Is a Stamp Rule
rules.body: Vermilion appears only on stamps, the active decision, verification marks, focus rings, slider thumbs, and the primary action — never as a decorative fill, background wash, or gradient.

rules.name: The Evidence Color Rule
rules.body: Risk-increasing evidence is vermilion (#bf3f1f); protective evidence is graph blue (#5b7a99). This split holds across factor bars, SHAP values, and drift bars.

rules.name: The Mono Is the Record Rule
rules.body: Anything the system produced — log lines, timestamps, readouts, numerals, table data cells — is JetBrains Mono with tabular numerals. Anything the shell says — titles, labels, buttons — is Archivo.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: The vermilion accent covers a small fraction of any screen. Its rarity is the point.

rules.name: The One Sheet Rule
rules.body: Only the sheet (and the memo sheet, a loose page on it) casts a soft shadow. Nothing else floats; elevation is expressed with ink rules and press shadows.

dos: Do keep all web fonts bundled locally (/fonts/fonts.css serving Archivo-var.woff2 and JetBrainsMono-var.woff2) — the app runs offline.
Do use the 2px radius and the ruled (not carded) section language everywhere.
Do set every consequential state as a stamped entry with timestamp + operator initials in THE LOG.
Do use tabular numerals for all readouts, tables, and gauges (mono face does this natively).
Do keep the educational disclaimer and "mockup"/"demo memo" honesty badges visible.
donts: Don't load fonts, icons, or assets from a CDN; Lucide inline SVGs only, no emojis (standing PRODUCT.md commitment).
Don't add cards, floating panels, or blurred drop shadows — the sheet is the only lifted surface; use ink rules.
Don't spend vermilion on decorative fills, gradients, or large areas; it is a stamp color.
Don't introduce corners rounder than 2px; a logbook is square-cut.
Don't fabricate operator initials, testimonials, benchmarks, or claims; empty states say the record is empty.
Don't add eyebrow kickers or marketing eyebrows above section titles; section heads are record lines (uppercase title + note over a rule), not campaign copy.
